edit.description: checkoutAt's refusal paragraph: the gate-time contract, not an unexported escape hatch

summary: Trade `checkoutAt`'s doc-comment escape hatch for the gate-time contract the package ships

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: The comment on `api.git.checkoutAt` names no route the package does not export; the refusal reads as gate-time by design, per `spec/harness.md`, *The runner interface*.
notes: `addWorktree`/`removeWorktree` (`src/git.ts`) are on neither `src/index.ts` nor `FlumeApi.git`, and `exports` reaches only `.` and `./harness` — the comment rides the shipped `.d.ts` and points at a route no consumer can take. `spec/harness.md` now rules the operation gate-time (0f9dfc8). `{@link}`s to internal symbols are TSDoc-normal and stay. Runtime unaffected: `namedLinesGate` runs through `runGate`, which opens the scope.

notes: Ruled a copy this tick. The roster spells nine of ten `RUNTIME_IGNORES` names plus `plan/pending.json`, never ignored, and omits `node_modules/`, which is.
